app_info.subtitle: Run and bid in club auctions
app_info.description: Auction Fish runs the fish and aquarium-plant auctions that aquarium clubs hold, and the club memberships behind them. Members can see what is for sale, add their own lots, bid, check what they owe and carry a membership card. The people running an auction can sign bidders in at the door, record what each lot sold for, settle invoices, and keep their club's members, events and breeder award points up to date. Every tool acts as the signed-in user and is refused whatever that person could not do on the website itself.

test_cases.description: Open a session by asking what the signed-in account is part of.
test_cases.user_prompt: What auctions and clubs am I part of?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists the auctions this account has joined or helps run and the clubs it belongs to, naming each one, so later requests can refer to an auction by name.

test_cases.description: Ask an auction's own rules and dates.
test_cases.user_prompt: What are the rules for the spring auction, and can I still add lots to it?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns that auction's dates, whether lot submission is still open, and the club's rules in full. Renders as the auction widget where the host supports one.

test_cases.description: Ask about one lot by the number printed on its label.
test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me about lot 14 in the spring auction.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns that lot's name, what it is, its photo, the current price and where it is collected. Renders as the lot widget where the host supports one.

test_cases.description: Add a lot for sale as the signed-in seller.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add a lot to the spring auction: 6 juvenile apistogramma cacatuoides, minimum bid $10.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the lot in that auction under this account and echoes back its lot number, the name and the minimum bid. Refused if lot submission has closed.

test_cases.description: Ask what this account owes or is owed.
test_cases.user_prompt: What do I owe for the spring auction?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns this account's own invoice for that auction, itemised, with the total and whether it is paid. Renders as the invoice widget where the host supports one.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general questions that have nothing to do with auctions or clubs.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What's the weather in Chicago tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked: it has no tool for weather and nothing in the request names an auction, a lot, a club or a member.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not attempt a bulk change; no tool here writes over a filter.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete every lot in the spring auction.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No tool should run. The server has no bulk write by design, and the app should say so rather than looping a single-row delete over an auction's lots.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not act on an auction this account does not administer.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Mark bidder 12's invoice as paid in the Ohio club's fall auction.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The request should not succeed. If the app tries, the server refuses it because the signed-in account has no admin rights on that auction; permission is checked on the server, never by the model.
